newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina issues $250 mln in 91-day Letes T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Argentina issues $250 mln in 91-day Letes T-bills.

text.p: Argentina sold $250 million of treasury bills (Letes) Tuesday at a cut-off yield of 6.10 percent, the Economy Ministry said.
The price at the cut-off yield was 98.4580. There were 69 bids for a bid-to-cover ratio of 3.05 times.
Of the $250 million sold, $41 million was allocated on non-competitive bids.
The cut-off yield of 6.10 percent was at the bottom end of market expectations.
At last month's auction of 182-day dollar bills there was a cut-off yield of 6.86 percent.
Market-makers will be offered up to 10 percent more of the issue until 5pm local time (2000 GMT) today.
Settlement for the issue is due on September 20.
